title: ElementalShaman SimulationCraft APL
content:
# Snapshot raid buffed stats before combat begins and pre-potting is done.
actions.precombat=snapshot_stats
actions.precombat+=/flametongue_weapon,if=talent.flametongue_weapon
actions.precombat+=/lightning_shield
actions.precombat+=/thunderstrike_ward
actions.precombat+=/variable,name=trinket_1_buffs,value=(trinket.1.has_use_buff|trinket.1.is.funhouse_lens)
actions.precombat+=/variable,name=trinket_2_buffs,value=(trinket.2.has_use_buff|trinket.2.is.funhouse_lens)
actions.precombat+=/stormkeeper

# Executed every time the actor is available.
# Enable more movement.
actions=spiritwalkers_grace,moving=1,if=movement.distance>6
# Interrupt of casts.
actions+=/wind_shear
actions+=/blood_fury
actions+=/berserking
actions+=/fireblood
actions+=/ancestral_call

# Normal buff trinkets, mimic Ascendance activation conditions
actions+=/use_item,slot=trinket1,use_off_gcd=1,if=variable.trinket_1_buffs&(cooldown.ascendance.remains>trinket.1.cooldown.duration-5|cooldown.ascendance.ready&cooldown.stormkeeper.remains>15|fight_remains<21)
actions+=/use_item,slot=trinket2,use_off_gcd=1,if=variable.trinket_2_buffs&(cooldown.ascendance.remains>trinket.2.cooldown.duration-5|cooldown.ascendance.ready&cooldown.stormkeeper.remains>15|fight_remains<21)
# Normal weapons
actions+=/use_item,slot=main_hand,use_off_gcd=1
# Dmg trinkets
actions+=/use_item,slot=trinket1,use_off_gcd=1,if=!variable.trinket_1_buffs&(cooldown.ascendance.remains>20|trinket.2.cooldown.remains>20)
actions+=/use_item,slot=trinket2,use_off_gcd=1,if=!variable.trinket_2_buffs&(cooldown.ascendance.remains>20|trinket.1.cooldown.remains>20)

actions+=/lightning_shield,if=buff.lightning_shield.down
actions+=/natures_swiftness
# Use Power Infusion on Cooldown.
actions+=/invoke_external_buff,name=power_infusion
actions+=/potion,if=buff.bloodlust.up|cooldown.ascendance.ready&cooldown.stormkeeper.remains>15|fight_remains<31
actions+=/run_action_list,name=aoe,if=spell_targets.chain_lightning>=3
actions+=/run_action_list,name=single_target

# Stormkeeper on CD, unless sub 10s hold for Asc or the fight is about to end.
actions.aoe=stormkeeper,if=cooldown.ascendance.remains>10|cooldown.ascendance.remains<gcd|fight_remains<20
actions.aoe+=/voltaic_blaze,if=time<3&talent.purging_flames
actions.aoe+=/ancestral_swiftness
# Ascendance on CD, unless SK can be sync'd with it.
actions.aoe+=/ascendance,if=cooldown.stormkeeper.remains>15|fight_remains<20

# [3t] Apply Flame shock on 3t for MotE and Inferno arc.
actions.aoe+=/flame_shock,if=!buff.master_of_the_elements.up&((dot.flame_shock.refreshable&cooldown.ascendance.remains>5)|(buff.fire_elemental.up&buff.fire_elemental.remains<2))&talent.master_of_the_elements&talent.inferno_arc&spell_targets.chain_lightning=3
# Apply Voltaic blaze for Inferno arc or Purging flames.
actions.aoe+=/voltaic_blaze,if=!buff.master_of_the_elements.up&((dot.flame_shock.refreshable&cooldown.ascendance.remains>5)|(buff.fire_elemental.up&buff.fire_elemental.remains<2)|talent.purging_flames&!buff.ascendance.up)

# Elemental Blast if no buffs or at 3t, Earthquake to spread Lightning Rod otherwise
actions.aoe+=/elemental_blast,target_if=min:debuff.lightning_rod.remains,if=buff.tempest.stack<2&(buff.elemental_blast_critical_strike.up+buff.elemental_blast_haste.up+buff.elemental_blast_mastery.up=0)
actions.aoe+=/earthquake,if=buff.tempest.stack<2&lightning_rod<active_enemies&spell_targets.chain_lightning>=3+talent.elemental_blast&(buff.elemental_blast_critical_strike.up+buff.elemental_blast_haste.up+buff.elemental_blast_mastery.up>0)
actions.aoe+=/elemental_blast,target_if=min:debuff.lightning_rod.remains,if=buff.tempest.stack<2&spell_targets.chain_lightning=3

# Spend Purging flames.
actions.aoe+=/lava_burst,if=buff.purging_flames.up&(buff.lava_surge.up|cooldown.voltaic_blaze.remains<2)
# [3t] Spend Lava Surge procs to buff Tempest with MotE.
actions.aoe+=/lava_burst,if=buff.tempest.up&buff.lava_surge.up&talent.master_of_the_elements&spell_targets.chain_lightning=3
# [3t] Tempest if you have MotE.
actions.aoe+=/tempest,target_if=min:debuff.lightning_rod.remains,if=buff.master_of_the_elements.up

actions.aoe+=/tempest,target_if=min:debuff.lightning_rod.remains,if=buff.stormkeeper.stack<4&buff.tempest.stack=2

actions.aoe+=/chain_lightning,if=buff.stormkeeper.up&maelstrom.deficit>(spell_targets.chain_lightning>?5)*(2+(spell_targets.chain_lightning>?5)+2)

actions.aoe+=/earthquake,if=!talent.elemental_blast&maelstrom.deficit<15+(buff.stormkeeper.up*(spell_targets.chain_lightning>?5)*(2+(spell_targets.chain_lightning>?5)))
actions.aoe+=/elemental_blast

actions.aoe+=/tempest,target_if=min:debuff.lightning_rod.remains
# Filler spell. Always available. Always the bottom line.
actions.aoe+=/chain_lightning

actions.aoe+=/flame_shock,moving=1
actions.aoe+=/voltaic_blaze,moving=1
actions.aoe+=/frost_shock,moving=1

# Stormkeeper on CD, unless sub 10s hold for Asc or the fight is about to end.
actions.single_target=stormkeeper,if=cooldown.ascendance.remains>10|cooldown.ascendance.remains<gcd|fight_remains<20
actions.single_target+=/ancestral_swiftness
# Ascendance on CD, unless SK can be sync'd with it.
actions.single_target+=/ascendance,if=cooldown.stormkeeper.remains>15|fight_remains<20

# Maintain Flame shock, minor gain to refresh it when FE is about to fade.
actions.single_target+=/flame_shock,if=!buff.master_of_the_elements.up&((dot.flame_shock.refreshable&cooldown.ascendance.remains>5)|(buff.fire_elemental.up&buff.fire_elemental.remains<2))
actions.single_target+=/voltaic_blaze,if=!buff.master_of_the_elements.up&((dot.flame_shock.refreshable&cooldown.ascendance.remains>5)|(buff.fire_elemental.up&buff.fire_elemental.remains<2)|talent.purging_flames&spell_targets.chain_lightning=2)

# Lava Burst if any empowering it talent chosen OR to consume surge procs.
actions.single_target+=/lava_burst,if=!buff.master_of_the_elements.up&maelstrom.deficit>15&(talent.master_of_the_elements|talent.molten_wrath|talent.call_of_the_ancestors|buff.lava_surge.up|talent.fusion_of_elements&(!buff.storm_elemental.up|buff.wind_gust.stack=4)|buff.purging_flames.up&(buff.lava_surge.up|cooldown.voltaic_blaze.remains<2))

# Tempest and Lightning Bolt with SK if you have MotE.
actions.single_target+=/tempest,if=buff.master_of_the_elements.up|!talent.master_of_the_elements
actions.single_target+=/lightning_bolt,if=buff.stormkeeper.up&(buff.master_of_the_elements.up|!talent.master_of_the_elements)

actions.single_target+=/elemental_blast,target_if=min:debuff.lightning_rod.remains
actions.single_target+=/earth_shock,target_if=min:debuff.lightning_rod.remains

actions.single_target+=/tempest
# Filler spell. Always available. Always the bottom line.
actions.single_target+=/chain_lightning,if=talent.call_of_the_ancestors&spell_targets.chain_lightning=2
actions.single_target+=/lightning_bolt

actions.single_target+=/flame_shock,moving=1
actions.single_target+=/voltaic_blaze,moving=1
actions.single_target+=/frost_shock,moving=1

 Welcome to the Elemental Shaman rotation guide for ! This guide will teach you all about the optimal rotation for Elemental Shaman across its various talent builds. It will cover both core ability cadence and cooldown usage in dungeons and raids for .

Overview
BiS Gear

Elemental Shaman Rotation in 

 

 

 
 Avoid Maelstrom waste: This resource enables us to cast our spender spenders, such as Earthquake and Earth Shock or Elemental Blast , so waste as little as possible. 
 

 

 
 

 
 Always Be Casting: Elemental Shaman lacks mobility cooldowns and tools for "quiet movement". As such it is not just important to know when you can move, it is also very important to know when you can either start moving early, or even better just not move at all. Utilize all your utility spells, such as Nature's Swiftness and Spiritwalker's Grace as much as possible and try to get your group to set up external mobility spells like Time Spiral . 
 

 

 
 

 
 React to procs: Elemental's has a few proc that can lead to moments of high damage or grant access to buffs to other spells. Namely, Ascendance strongly buffs spells cast during its duration, so syncing your cooldowns and pooling resources like Maelstrom or Tempest procs is important here. On the other hand, Lava Surge procs give access to Master of the Elements which should be spent on your highest damage spells like e.g. Tempest . 
 

 

Elemental Shaman Starter Guide

 Best Elemental Shaman Rotation

Below, we break down the main priority lists for Elemental Shaman: Single-Target Rotation, AoE Rotation, and your opener sequence.

 Best Elemental Shaman Single Target Rotation

 Elemental Shaman in Single Target plays around a priority list, juggling both ability cooldowns and resources based on an order of power. This means with each GCD we go top to bottom on a list, and press the button with the current highest value.
 With selected, the priority is as follows: With selected, the priority is as follows:

 Best Elemental Shaman AoE Rotation

 For Elemental Shaman there is very little overlap between Single Target and AoE. AoE starts at 3 targets where we replace Lightning Bolt with Chain Lightning . The breakpoint for your spenders depends on your chosen talents.
 With selected, the priority is as follows: With selected, the priority is as follows:

 The builds used below are covered in the Talents page. Anywhere you see the icon, you can hover over it for additional notes. 

 
Priority

 
Remember to use Spiritwalker's Grace and Nature's Swiftness for movement events.

Cast Stormkeeper on cooldown.

Cast Ancestral Swiftness roughly on cooldown.

Cast Ascendance roughly on cooldown, but always after Stormkeeper 

Cast Chain Lightning as your filler.
 

 Further Details 

 Lava Surge procs should on average happen in a way that you get one Surge proc for each Purging Flames if you run no CDR talents. If you run Crackling Fury , you will need to cast some Lava Burst as "hardcasts", i.e. without Lava Surge. Ancestors send a Lava Burst whenever you apply Flame Shock with spells such as Voltaic Blaze or Ascendance , so remember to line those up whenever possible.

 The builds used below are covered in the Talents page. Anywhere you see the icon, you can hover over it for additional notes. 

 
Priority

Cast Ascendance roughly on cooldown, but always after Stormkeeper 

Cast Chain Lightning / Tempest as your filler.
 

 Best Elemental Shaman Opener

 The Elemental opener is pretty basic. You stack your cooldowns and just try to get them on cooldown as early as possible. You can use the buttons below to display openers for both single-target and AoE, depending on your chosen Hero Talent .With selected, opener details are as follows:With selected, opener details are as follows:

 Please select a Hero Talent option to generate an Opener sequence 

 The builds used below are covered in the Talents page. Anywhere you see the icon, you can hover over it for additional notes.

Continue with normal priority

Continue with normal priority
 

 
Pre-Combat Check

 Before any combat happens, it is important for Elemental Shaman to make sure the following are done. This applies to raids, dungeons, delves, or even open-world content.

 Elemental Shaman Major Cooldowns

Elemental has access to a variety of different cooldowns on its spec tree. All of them come with some extra wrinkles in how they work rather than simply being flat increases, so the below section covers how they work, and most importantly, how to get the most out of each use.

 Stormkeeper 

 Stormkeeper is our main short cooldown spell. For Lightning Bolt it increases the damage of the next 2 casts by 150% and force it to trigger one additional overload. For Chain Lightning it does not directly increase the damage, but instead triggers an additional overload on every target hit.

The tier set improves this cooldown to instead buff the next 3 casts by an extra 25% up to 175% for Lightning Bold and 25% for Chain Lightning and also giving some Haste whenever you activate the cooldown.

Try to sync this with Ascendance , which buffs the resulting overloads quite substantially.

In addition to the aformentioned points, for Farseer this cooldown also spawns an Ancestor, significantly increasing the effective damage done by this cooldown.

 Ascendance 

 Ascendance casts Flame Shock on up to 6 enemies within range that you are in combat with. While active, it buffs your Overloads by 75% and makes all spells that can overload do so exactly one additional time. For Instakill this means that you get one additional overload on the main target of the cast.

If you are specced into Call of Fire this spell also spawns a Fire Elemental , which buffs the duration and tick rate of Flame Shock . Be aware that the Elemental is only active after the initial Flame Shocks are applied, so you need to make sure to cast another Flame Shock in the GCD at the end of the duration of the Elemental but after the Ascendance expired.

Make sure to use spells that trigger more overloads or more spells that can overload before you go into Ascendance, like Stormkeeper and Voltaic Blaze (if in AoE and specced into Purging Flames ).

 Elemental Shaman Advanced Tips

]
 
 Farseer AoE 

 Farseer relies on the damage down by the Ancestors spawned whenever you press either Stormkeeper or Ancestral Swiftness . In general, the Ancestors are duplicating your spell casts in that they cast Lava Burst whenever you cast a "Single-Target" spell, and Chain Lightning whenever you cast an "AoE" spell. The classification for "Single Target" and "AoE" is pretty intuitive and would exceed this little tip box, but it is important to note that fundamentally only "actual spell casts" trigger the Ancestors. If you cast a spell such Lava Burst , your Ancestors will also send a Single Target Lava Burst , but any overloads on that spell will be ignored by them. The exception to this rule are all spells that trigger Flame Shock to be applied to enemies. For some reason, these are still reacted to by the Ancestors, triggering a Lava Burst on each target.

 So what does this mean rotationally?

 Always try to line up your Ascendance and Voltaic Blaze right after you cast your Stormkeeper and Ancestral Swiftness, but try to cast the Voltaic Blaze outside of the Ascendance window. In other words your burst window should look like this:

 Stormkeeper>>Ancestral Swiftness>>Voltaic Blaze>>Ascendance.

 
How does Randomness work for Elemental? 

 Most, if not all, random procs in the spec rely on a system commonly known as "Deck of Cards". In summary, random procs like Tempest or Routine Communication use very strong bad luck protection, forcing a certain amount of successes within a certain amount of "attempts", normalizing proc rates and limiting variance.

 Playing around these mechanics and effectively "predicting" random procs during normal gameplay can lead to notable DPS increases but usually requires external tools to simplify tracking of the actual proc chances at any given moment.

 With the changes to addons, it has becomes significantly hard to do so, but by no means impossible. While currently there are no addons available that implement this functionality for Elemental, it is only a matter of time.

 On a similar note, while to our knowledge Lava Surge doesn't use this explicit deck system, its procs are also strongly normalized and can effectively be predicted during normal gameplay. This knowledge can be very helpful to achieve very minor DPS gains via Master of the Elements allowing players that are very comfortable and used to the spec to hold Maelstrom when they can "feel" a proc coming, and on the other hand, hold a Lava Surge proc for a while, because for the first 3 or so seconds, it is effectively impossible to immediately get another proc and overwrite the existing one.

 
How do I minmax my damage with Purging Flames? 

 For a very unintuitive "trick" and tip we can take a look at the functionality of Purging Flames . This spell makes it so that your next Lava Burst is "echoed" at up to 5 other targets that are not your main target with an active Flame Shock . Because the echoes are limited to a number lower than the active Flame Shocks and cant hit your main target, a weird little quirk appears where if you fight a number of enemies and you have less than 6 Flame Shock active, but you have at least one extra target without a Flame Shock, then casting Lava Burst against this target becomes optimal.

 As an example, if you are fighting 6 targets and you only hit 5 of those with your Voltaic Blaze , if you then cast your Lava Burst against a target with Flame Shock, you get your main cast and 4 "echoes", one per other target with a Flame Shock. If you instead cast the Lava Burst against the target without a Flame Shock, you get your main cast which loses its guaranteed crit, and then you get 5 "echoes" instead.

 All in all, this is very situational, and should not be played around by most people, but if you are desperate for ways to minmax, this is one of the possible ways to do so.

Our Elemental Shaman guides are always updated with the latest information from in-game experience, simulations, and logs. Make sure to check our changelog for this page by clicking on View Changelog in the Quick Facts column or on the book icon at the top of the page. Comment by Augmentum 
In reality, most battles are very short and only require this simple rotation:

 Single target: 
 
Voltaic Blaze (periodically refresh the Flame Shock dot) — generates a maelstrom 

Lava Burst (Don't forget to use the Purging Flames proc) — generates maelstrom

Lightning bolt (use as a filler when everything else is on cooldown and don't have enough maelstrom for Earth Shock/Elemental Blast) — generates maelstrom

Earth Shock or Elemental Blast — spends maelstrom 

Tempest (use as much as possible) — generates maelstrom
 

 If there are more than 2 targets 
 
Voltaic Blaze — generates a maelstrom

Lava Burst (use only when there is a Purging Flames proc) — generates maelstrom

Chain Lightning — generates a maelstrom

Earthquake — spends maelstrom 

Tempest (use as much as possible) — generates maelstrom
 

This is enough for most people who are casual or semi-hardcore players.

The Wowhead Client is a little application we use to keep our database up to date, and to provide you with some nifty extra functionality on the website! 

 

 
It serves 2 main purposes: 

 
 

It maintains a WoW addon called the Wowhead Looter , which collects data as you play the game! 

 

It uploads the collected data to Wowhead in order to keep the database up-to-date! 

 

 
You can also use it to keep track of your completed quests, recipes, mounts, companion pets, and titles! 

 

 
So, what are you waiting for? Download the client and get started.
